concept.title: Choose the right BPM surface
concept.shortdesc: BPM has five user surfaces: Library, Guided Editor, All Settings, JSON Editor, and Compare.

conbody.p: Choose the surface by the outcome you want, not by the internal product module.

dlentry.dd: Find, create, import, duplicate, archive, restore, delete, export, and open profiles.
Create or update common policy configurations through task-first steps and starter choices.
Review attention items, browse the full supported policy and preference catalog, and edit detailed values.
Inspect or edit the exact Firefox policies document when precise raw control is needed.
Compare two saved profiles and understand equal, different, or missing settings.
